features.name: Conditional Settings on Build Mode
features.description: Ability to define conditional settings in AL Go for GitHub based on build mode (e.g., default vs next major). Settings can be overridden based on which build mode is active.
features.status_evidence_quote: in the latest month we released version 6.3 there were like four uh things in that one besid some some fixes and stuff like

features.name: Preprocessor Symbols
features.description: Support for preprocessor symbols in AL Go for GitHub, allowing developers to define custom symbols and use them in AL code to conditionally compile based on build mode or other conditions.

features.name: Removal of This Build Artifacts
features.description: Elimination of temporary this build artifacts that were previously created for multi-project repository builds. Now always produce normal artifacts instead, which can be used for testing before pull request approval.
caveats: Artifacts now have different naming conventions based on workflow type

features.name: Versioning Strategy 3
features.description: New versioning strategy where major, minor, and build numbers come from app.json, and only the revision number (fourth digit) is determined by the run number. Simplifies semantic versioning for releases.
caveats: Only applies when using versioning strategy 3
Run attempts no longer increment version on rebuild

features.name: Compiler Folder for Container Builds
features.description: Enhancement to AL Go pipeline allowing compilation using compiler folder before creating the container, resulting in faster compile times though slightly slower overall build times.
caveats: Overall build may be slightly slower
Requires separate project setup for optimal performance

features.name: Use Workflow From Branch
features.description: GitHub Actions feature that allows specifying which branch's workflow code to execute. Runs action in the context of the specified branch for source code and configuration.
caveats: Using old branches will run old version of AL Go which may not work
Maria working on PR to update AL Go system files across multiple branches

features.name: Scheduled Publish to Environment
features.description: Capability to schedule deployment to production environments outside working hours using a YAML file that spawns the publish to environment action with a schedule.
caveats: Requires manual YAML file creation
Documentation to be created within 1-2 weeks

features.name: Incremental Builds
features.description: Pull request feature that only builds and deploys apps that have changed or depend on changed apps, rather than rebuilding all apps in the repository. Multiple apps in one repository or multi-project repositories can benefit from selective builds.
features.status_evidence_quote: we're expecting that one to get in uh preview within the next few uh weeks
caveats: Changes to low-level apps will still rebuild all dependent apps
Currently in PR/preview status
Deployment time is a limiting factor, not build time
Currently not available - requires enabling after PR merge

features.name: Results Viewer for Page Scripting Tasks
features.description: New tool being developed by Sebastian to view results from page scripting test execution in AL Go for GitHub.
caveats: May not be completed with version 7 release in April
Page scripting tasks in QA environment faces MFA authentication issues

features.name: Page Scripting Tasks in QA Deployment
features.description: Feature to run page scripting tasks as part of deployment to QA environment to verify they complete with customer data.
caveats: Page scripting runner does not work with MFA
Many users have or must enable MFA for authorization

features.name: NuGet Feed Support for External Dependencies
features.description: AL Go for GitHub supports using NuGet feeds as a provider and consumer of NuGet packages for automatic dependency resolution.
caveats: AppSource symbols feed is automatically trusted but can only be used for compilation, not test running
NuGet configuration guidance for partners needs improvement

features.name: Local Development Container with Private Repositories
features.description: Local development creates containers that require GitHub user permissions to read and install all dependencies including from private repositories and NuGet feeds.
caveats: If user lacks permissions to dependencies, installation fails
No workaround currently available
GitHub packages are not supported in local dev

features.name: Publishing to NuGet Feed Model
features.description: Proposed future model where apps are published to a NuGet feed and installations are pulled from the environment based on environment-defined schedules instead of pushing from GitHub.
caveats: Timeline is one to two years out
Currently only publish-to-environment model is available

features.name: Generate Dependency Artifacts
features.description: A setting that creates build artifacts containing all dependencies used for builds, stored in an artifact called project branch dependencies with version numbers.
caveats: not currently used by local development
Proposal to use this instead of rebuilding in local dev is under discussion

features.name: Self-Hosted Runner Support for All Workflows
features.description: Ability to run all workflows on self-hosted runners by configuring the runs-on setting without editing YAML files. Two settings determine runner selection: GitHub Runner for build jobs and runs-on for other workflows.
caveats: update ELO system files workflow always uses GitHub hosted runner
runner groups must match the syntax specified in runs-on setting

features.name: Configuration Packages for Test Data
features.description: Ability to define configuration packages that are applied during build and container pipeline runs. Different configuration packages can be specified per localization version.
caveats: custom configuration can also be done via import test data NPC container script

features.name: Import Test Data NPC Container Override
features.description: A custom script option called import test data NPC container that allows custom configuration and demo data setup during container pipeline runs.
caveats: requires writing custom scripts

features.name: Dotnet Sign Integration for Code Signing
features.description: AL Go utilizes dotnet sign for application code signing. Supports certificates from various sources and can potentially be extended to support additional certificate authorities or vaults.
caveats: limited to what dotnet sign supports
custom CA vaults may require PR contribution

features.name: Resources in Test Apps
features.description: For AL 4.2, resources can be included in the app itself. For test apps, resources could be used in the initialization step to load configuration data.
caveats: Different loading means for test vs regular apps

features.name: Configuration Packages Deprecation
features.description: Configuration packages are being phased out. Extended demo data will no longer be shipped as configuration packages but as demo data apps. The functionality is maintained but the artifact format is changing.
caveats: Current versions still ship configuration packages
Deprecation timeline not specified

features.name: AL-Go Telemetry Module
features.description: AL-Go has a telemetry module that records data. The team is considering creating KQL queries and dashboards to help analyze telemetry data, errors, and usage patterns.
caveats: KQL queries not yet available
Dashboard concept is proposed but not yet built
Module is relatively new

features.name: Commitment to Net Sign
features.description: The team has decided to standardize on net sign for code signing. They recommend against using the old SDK sign tool and will not accept PRs proposing alternative signing approaches.
caveats: Old sign tool requires manual SDK library management
net sign is considered the right choice

features.name: Extension Cleanup on Deployment
features.description: Old published but uninstalled extensions remain cluttered in the extensions list after deployments. The team is investigating whether unpublishing can be done as part of deployment.
caveats: No current unpublish mechanism in the API
Extensions are unpublished on major/minor updates

features.name: AL-Go Workshop
features.description: The AL-Go Workshop is available as a training resource. The team recognizes it needs additional attention and is planning new workshop content on using AL-Go, not just setting it up.
caveats: Workshop needs more love and attention
Coverage focuses on setup rather than daily usage
Gap in documentation for consultants and users

features.name: Single Sign-On Enforcement
features.description: Single sign-on can be set at the organizational level in GitHub. Users belonging to an organization can be forced to authenticate with Microsoft credentials and MFA.
caveats: Must be configured at organizational level
Requires Microsoft organization membership

features.name: Key Vault Credential Configuration
features.description: Key Vault connections can be set up using federated credentials or an Azure AD app with Key Vault access, rather than storing user credentials.
caveats: Multiple configuration approaches available

features.name: Federated Identities for Keyword Authentication
features.description: Authentication method for connecting to keyword using federated credentials or AAD app credentials instead of user credentials, providing more secure access control.
caveats: Documentation for federated credentials is needed in the workshop

features.name: Multi-Project Repository Support
features.description: AL-Go allows multiple projects in a single repository, where each project can have multiple apps and can target different localizations of Business Central artifacts. Projects within a repository are typically released together.
caveats: Local development environment currently only works for one project at a time
Localized versions must compile with corresponding artifact versions

features.name: GitHub Packages for Dependency Resolution
features.description: Recommended approach for resolving dependencies between apps in the same organization by using GitHub Packages instead of putting all apps in one repository.
caveats: Recommendation applies when repositories are in the same organization
Single repository approach is acceptable if there are not strict borders between apps

features.name: Local Development Environment in AL-Go
features.description: AL-Go supports creating local development environments through scripts that work with AL-Go folder structure in a project. Currently only one project can have an active local dev environment at a time.
caveats: Local dev environment only works for one project at a time
Cannot work on all projects simultaneously
Container must be connected to one project due to artifact requirements
